### [3:10–4:45] COST 2 — THE 3-NUMBER ROI CHECK (the original framework)
**NARRATION:** "Now the part that actually decides it — and it's just three numbers. I call it
the Three-Number ROI Check. Number one: how many hours does this automation save you every
month? Number two: what is one hour of your time worth? Not minimum wage — what an hour of the
owner's time is really worth, because that's the time you're buying back. Number three: what
does the tool cost per month? Then: hours saved, times your hourly value, minus the tool cost.
Let's run it. Say chasing invoices eats six hours a month. Your time's worth fifty dollars an
hour. That's three hundred dollars of your time. The tool costs twenty. Three hundred minus
twenty is two hundred eighty dollars of return — every single month — from one automation. If
that number's positive, stop overthinking it and build it."
**[VISUAL]:** The three numbers fill in one at a time — **6 hrs · $50/hr · $20/mo** — then the
